HIST 105: The Modern Middle East
Fall 2026
Tuesdays & Thursdays, 1:25–2:40 PM, White Hall 106

This syllabus uses week numbers rather than calendar dates so that it can be
reused across terms. Week 1 is the first week of instruction.

ASSESSMENT SCHEDULE

Week 2, Thursday — Response Paper 1 (2 pages) submitted to Canvas
Week 4, Tuesday — Map Quiz, in class
Week 6, Thursday — Midterm Examination, in class, White Hall 106
Week 8, Tuesday — Response Paper 2
Week 9, Thursday — Research proposal and annotated bibliography, by 5pm
Week 11, Tuesday — Response Paper 3
Week 13, Thursday — Draft of final essay, for peer review
Week 15, Thursday — Final Essay (12–15 pages) due

The final examination is scheduled by the registrar during exam week and the
date will be posted on the university calendar once available.

READINGS
Weekly readings are listed on Canvas. You are expected to complete the reading
before the first meeting of each week.
